contract: Durable foundation record/package/promote/inherit/adopt/withdraw lifecycle with SHA-256 candidate fingerprints, explicit provenance, and local-only style. The built-in ambient_beacon controller installs, arms, restarts, stops, retires and reconciles by executing constrained verbs through the canonical separately installed managed world engine; durable desired state is distinct from engine acknowledgements.

dependencies.experience.10: b5dd953c locally qualified canonical managed world engine, signed world operations, durable worlds and guest identity protocol

shared_hooks: Root dashboard handler registers register_world_foundations(app, app[STORE]) from world_foundations_http
Root Console experience page mounts WorldFoundations
remaining_limits: Cross-instance transport of candidate and withdrawal envelopes remains owned by the platform peer integration; this slice verifies the exact receiving contract on a second durable instance
Controller definitions are intentionally restricted to the built-in ambient_beacon; arbitrary scripts, permissions and configured-record-only controllers are refused
